Overview

The YB prefabricated substation installs the transformer, high-voltage switchgear, low-voltage switchgear and other switchgear in the box-type housing, with LV metering, compensation and auxiliary power as needed.

Widely used in power systems, public and high-rise buildings, stadiums, industrial and mining enterprises, traffic stations and new-energy PV and wind generation; serves as a permanent installation or construction-site supply, for ring-network or terminal distribution with cable transmission.

Design and performance

Functional features

Free combination
High- and low-voltage switches and transformers are not restricted; internal components are easy to operate and repair.
Appearance
Neat, regular and easy to lift and install.
Unattended
Simple installation, fast power supply, simple maintenance without personnel on duty.
Thermal design
Heat-insulated, ventilated enclosure with upper and lower vents; forced-air cooling and automatic temperature control can be installed.
Enclosure
Cold-rolled steel, stainless steel, GRC cement, colour steel or aluminium-zinc coated colour strip wood.
Altitude
Suitable for installation below 3000 m.
